AFDK's Videncenter, referred to in the source document as RKKP's Videncenter, is an analytical unit operating under the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP) [^src1]. It acts as a central operational entity in the production of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) annual reports, bearing the specific responsibility for preparing and conducting the report's core analyses [^src1]. Through its analytical work, the center underpins RKKP's broader strategic shifts—such as the transition from hospital-centered to population-based quality measurement across Denmark's 21 health clusters—ultimately supporting integrated healthcare strategies and technical quality documentation for atrial fibrillation treatment.
